title: GTA 6 Broke YouTube Before It Even Launched 🤯
description: GTA 6 videos racked up tens of billions of views before the game was even out. Here are the numbers behind the hype.
topic: GTA 6 YouTube view records before launch

scenes.line: GTA 6 broke the internet before it even launched.
scenes.visual: Aerial night shot of a tropical neon coastal city with palm-lined boulevards

scenes.line: Pre-launch GTA 6 videos alone pulled in over forty billion views on YouTube.
scenes.visual: Dark room with hundreds of glowing phone screens floating in the air

scenes.line: And all GTA videos combined? More than nine hundred billion.
scenes.visual: Generic unbranded sports car racing down a coastal highway at sunset

scenes.line: That's over a hundred views for every single person on Earth.
scenes.visual: Planet Earth from space at night covered in glowing city lights
